explanation.en: “The library has four study rooms” → four (or 4). “Six chairs” is the chairs in each room.
explanation.kk: «The library has four study rooms» → four (немесе 4). «Six chairs» — әр бөлмедегі орындық.
explanation.ru: «The library has four study rooms» → four (или 4). «Six chairs» — стулья в каждой комнате.

RT-GT-SA-01-Q1.quote: The library has four study rooms

explanation.en: “a screen that can be connected to a laptop” → a laptop (or laptop).
explanation.kk: «a screen that can be connected to a laptop» → a laptop (немесе laptop) — экранды қосатын құрылғы.
explanation.ru: «a screen that can be connected to a laptop» → a laptop (или laptop).

RT-GT-SA-01-Q2.quote: a screen that can be connected to a laptop

explanation.en: Rooms can be booked “for a maximum of three hours per day”. “Longest time” means “maximum”, so the answer is three hours.
explanation.kk: Бөлмені «for a maximum of three hours per day» брондауға болады. Сұрақтағы «longest time» — «maximum» дегені, жауап three hours.
explanation.ru: Комнату можно бронировать «for a maximum of three hours per day». «Longest time» в вопросе значит «maximum», ответ three hours.

RT-GT-SA-01-Q3.quote: Rooms can be booked for a maximum of three hours per day

explanation.en: “Food is not allowed in the study rooms” → food. Drinks in bottles with lids are actually allowed.
explanation.kk: «Food is not allowed in the study rooms» → food. Қақпағы бар бөтелкедегі сусынға, керісінше, рұқсат.
explanation.ru: «Food is not allowed in the study rooms» → food. Напитки в бутылках с крышкой, наоборот, разрешены.

RT-GT-SA-01-Q4.quote: Food is not allowed in the study rooms

explanation.en: “collect the key from the information desk” → information desk. “The information desk” is three words, over the limit.
explanation.kk: «collect the key from the information desk» → information desk. «The information desk» — үш сөз, шектен асады.
explanation.ru: «collect the key from the information desk» → information desk. «The information desk» — три слова, больше лимита.

RT-GT-SA-01-Q5.quote: Please collect the key from the information desk
